source: Death Guard Faction Pack v1.0, pages 8-17

group.title: Legends
group.description: Official Warhammer Legends datasheets from Death Guard Faction Pack v1.0.

units.title: Death Guard Possessed

abilities.title: Infectious Bloodshed
abilities.text: Each time this unit makes a Charge move, until the end of the turn, weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

wargearAbilities.title: Diseased Icon
wargearAbilities.text: Melee weapons in the bearer's unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

wargearOptions: 1 model can be equipped with 1 diseased icon.
units.composition: 1 Possessed Champion; 4-9 Possessed. Each model is equipped with: hideous mutations.
units.transport: For the purposes of embarking within Transports, each Death Guard Possessed model counts as one Terminator model.

units.title: Death Guard Chaos Lord

abilities.title: Chaos Lord
abilities.text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

abilities.title: Desiccation Conduit (Aura)
abilities.text: While an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of this model, at the end of the turn, roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

wargearOptions: This model's plague bolt pistol can be replaced with 1 combi-weapon, 1 plague combi-bolter, 1 plague fist, 1 plague-encrusted exalted weapon or 1 plasma pistol.
This model's Astartes chainsword can be replaced with 1 plague fist or 1 plague-encrusted exalted weapon.
This model's plague bolt pistol and Astartes chainsword can be replaced with 1 twin lightning claws.
units.composition: 1 Death Guard Chaos Lord. This model is equipped with: plague bolt pistol; Astartes chainsword.
units.leader: This model can be attached to: Plague Marines.

units.title: Death Guard Chaos Lord in Terminator Armour

abilities.title: Chaos Lord
abilities.text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

abilities.title: Desiccation Conduit (Aura)
abilities.text: While an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of this model, at the end of the turn, roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

wargearOptions: This model's plague combi-bolter can be replaced with 1 combi-weapon or 1 plague-encrusted exalted weapon.
This model's plague-encrusted exalted weapon can be replaced with 1 chainfist or 1 plague fist.
This model's plague combi-bolter and plague-encrusted exalted weapon can be replaced with 1 twin lightning claws.
units.composition: 1 Death Guard Chaos Lord in Terminator Armour. This model is equipped with: plague combi-bolter; plague-encrusted exalted weapon.
units.leader: This model can be attached to: Blightlord Terminators; Deathshroud Terminators.

units.title: Death Guard Cultists
wargearOptions: For every 10 models in the unit, 1 Death Guard Cultist's Cultist firearm can be replaced with 1 flamer.
For every 10 models in the unit, 1 Death Guard Cultist's Cultist firearm can be replaced with 1 heavy stubber.
For every 10 models in the unit, 1 Death Guard Cultist's Cultist firearm can be replaced with 1 grenade launcher.
units.composition: 1 Death Guard Cultist Champion; 9-19 Death Guard Cultists. Every model is equipped with: Cultist firearm; brutal assault weapon.

units.title: Death Guard Sorcerer in Terminator Armour

weapons.name: Curse of the Leper - focused witchfire

abilities.title: Putrescent Vitality (Psychic)
abilities.text: At the start of the Fight phase, you can roll one D6: on a 1, this Psyker's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 2+, until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in this Psyker's unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

abilities.title: Pestilent Familiar (Psychic)
abilities.text: Once per battle, after selecting targets for a Psychic weapon equipped by this model, until the end of the phase, improve the Strength and Damage characteristics of that weapon by 2.

units.designerNote: Place a Pestilent Familiar token next to this model, removing it once this ability has been used.
wargearOptions: This model's plague combi-bolter can be replaced with 1 combi-weapon or 1 plague-encrusted exalted weapon.
This model's force weapon can be replaced with 1 chainfist, 1 plague fist or 1 plague-encrusted exalted weapon.
This model's plague combi-bolter and force weapon can be replaced with 1 twin lightning claws.
units.composition: 1 Death Guard Sorcerer in Terminator Armour. This model is equipped with: Curse of the Leper; plague combi-bolter; force weapon.
units.leader: This model can be attached to: Blightlord Terminators; Deathshroud Terminators.
